description: Malina is the Sun goddess of Greenlandic Inuit tradition, sister of Aningaat the Moon. The input's core description is accurate; it is a genuine Greenlandic variant of the pan-Arctic sun-moon myth.

Ka'wimosa is the Zuni priest called 'Kachina Maker,' central to the search for itiwana: his eldest son Kiaklo journeyed north, and the Ánahoho áchi (his next two sons) went south; these journeys underpin the kachina origin tradition. The input's fun fact is essentially correct. Related entries (pautiwa-pueblo, aaototo-kachina-hopi, pongo-hopi) fit the kachina sphere.
